title: Beyond the Hydrophobic Trough of PfAMA1: Pivotal Roles of Cryptic Loop Dynamics Inform Anti-Malarial Therapeutic Design.
one_liner_zh: 该文以疟原虫蛋白PfAMA1的隐蔽环动态为对象，探讨其构象异质性对抑制剂设计的影响，并强调结合构象系综建模与机器学习优化药物，虽非直接提出新算法，但聚焦蛋白构象动态与结构计算设计，与课题相关。
abstract: Protein loops often mediate dynamic, conformation-dependent molecular recognition. This perspective examines the essential interaction between Plasmodium falciparum apical membrane antigen 1 (PfAMA1) and rhoptry neck protein 2 (PfRON2), which drives moving-junction formation and erythrocyte invasion. We focus on the PfAMA1 domain 2 (D2) loop and its role in regulating native and therapeutic peptide binding. D2-loop closure creates a cryptic subpocket, termed Hotspot-3, through hydrophobic packing reinforced by hydrogen bonds. This conformational heterogeneity complicates structure-based inhibitor design because binders must either stabilize preferred loop states or accommodate loop dynamics. These findings highlight residence-time optimization, rather than affinity alone, as a key objective for next-generation PfAMA1 inhibitors. Small molecules may also target PfAMA1, although the ligandability of Hotspot-3 remains unproven. Strategies combining N-terminal helicity, cryptic-pocket engagement, conformational-ensemble modelling, and machine learning may enable longer-acting and potentially strain-transcending antimalarial therapeutics. However, Hotspot-3 conservation and sustained inhibition require validation across divergent PfAMA1 alleles.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质环状结构域常常介导动态的、构象依赖的分子识别。本文探讨了恶性疟原虫顶端膜抗原1（PfAMA1）与棒状体颈部蛋白2（PfRON2）之间的关键相互作用，该作用驱动移动连接的形成和红细胞入侵。我们聚焦于PfAMA1结构域2（D2）环及其在调控天然和治疗性肽结合中的作用。D2环的闭合通过疏水堆积和氢键增强作用，形成了一个隐蔽亚口袋，称为Hotspot-3。这种构象异质性使基于结构的抑制剂设计复杂化，因为结合物必须稳定有利的环状态或适应环的动态变化。这些发现强调了停留时间优化，而非仅亲和力，作为下一代PfAMA1抑制剂的关键目标。小分子也可能靶向PfAMA1，尽管Hotspot-3的可配体性尚未得到证实。结合N端螺旋性、隐蔽口袋参与、构象集合建模和机器学习的策略，可能有助于开发长效且可能跨越菌株的抗疟治疗药物。然而，Hotspot-3的保守性和持续抑制效果需要在不同PfAMA1等位基因间进行验证。
